title: Bail Organa
subtitle: House Organa
description: Bail Organa was the beloved Senator of the peaceful planet of Alderaan and the adoptive father of Princess Leia Organa. Though Organa appeared to loyally serve the Empire, in secret, he conspired to help develop the Rebel Alliance and topple Emperor Palpatine's cruel regime. When Leia was kidnapped by group of mercenaries led by Vect Nokru, Bail called out to his old friend, Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, with hopes of rescuing her.
